entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing Black man with a serious expression, wearing traditional African attire including a beaded headband with feathers, a large V-shaped beaded necklace, and a fringed cloth wrap around his waist. He is bare-chested and barefoot, standing on sandy ground in front of a thatched structure.

clothing.headwear: beaded headband with red, white, and blue beads and two feathers (one dark, one white)
clothing.necklace: large V-shaped beaded necklace with red, white, and blue beads and a central pendant
clothing.lower_body: beige fringed cloth wrap tied at the waist with a brown knot

attributes.background: sandy ground and thatched roof structure

A young Black man stands barefoot on sandy ground, wearing traditional African attire consisting of a beaded headband with a single feather, a large V-shaped beaded necklace in red, white, and blue, and a striped wrap skirt with fringed ends.
